research.title: Support Request Classification Across Product Categories
bullets: Cleaned support request text, standardized category labels, and removed duplicate messages before constructing training and evaluation splits.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines using specified preprocessing settings, then inspected classification errors involving overlapping product terminology.

research.title: Lexical Baselines for Question Pair Matching
bullets: Prepared labeled question pairs by normalizing whitespace, checking missing text, and separating repeated questions across the supplied dataset partitions.
Implemented a word overlap baseline and TF-IDF cosine similarity scoring, documenting false matches caused by shared vocabulary with different intent.

work.title: Text Import Validation and Maintenance
bullets: Maintained Python routines for importing text records, validating required fields, and reporting malformed entries for correction before downstream processing.
Added regression tests for encoding errors and missing fields, and reproduced reported import failures using sanitized sample records.

projects.title: Movie Review Sentiment Classification Baseline
bullets: Implemented a multinomial naive Bayes classifier with bag-of-words features for labeled movie reviews, following the assigned baseline specification.
Compared count and TF-IDF feature representations on held-out reviews, and categorized prediction errors involving negation, mixed sentiment, and uncommon vocabulary.
